text.p: -- Caspian Securities initiated coverage of Mexican telecommunications firm Carso Global Telecom and Media September 20 with a market performer rating at a price of 31.3 pesos per share

-- Analysts Martn Lara and Joanne Smith said the company, created when Grupo Carso spun off its telecommunications assets including Telfonos de Mxico shares in July, is trading at a 12 percent premium to its estimated net asset value.

-- Caspian said it believed Telecom's share price would be driven by the value of its existing net assets (Telmex shares), its ability to acquire undervalued assets, and the premium investors are willing to pay over its net asset value.
-- Estimated 1996 and 1997 price/earnings ratios 12.9 and 11.9 respectively reflect premiums of 57 percent and 36 percent to Telmex, its largest asset.
-- Caspian said its 12-month price target of 31.3 pesos per share represented a nominal peso return of 46 percent and a U.S. dollar return of 22 percent.
